description: This file defines a session handler class for managing chat completion message histories, including retrieval and extension based on spend logs, with integration for cold storage and external logging.

classes.name: ResponsesSessionHandler
classes.description: A handler class providing static methods to manage chat message histories, including retrieval, extension, and integration with cold storage based on spend logs.

methods.name: get_chat_completion_message_history_for_previous_response_id
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs chat message history for a given previous response ID, including spend logs and session ID.

methods.name: extend_chat_completion_message_with_spend_log_payload
methods.description: Extends chat message history with data from a spend log payload, transforming responses and adding messages.

methods.name: get_proxy_server_request_from_spend_log
methods.description: Extracts and parses the proxy server request from a spend log, possibly retrieving from cold storage if configured.

methods.name: _get_cold_storage_object_key_from_spend_log
methods.description: Extracts the cold storage object key from spend log metadata.

methods.name: get_proxy_server_request_from_cold_storage_with_object_key
methods.description: Retrieves proxy server request data from cold storage using an object key.

methods.name: _should_check_cold_storage_for_full_payload
methods.description: Determines whether to check cold storage for full payload based on request content and configuration.

methods.name: get_all_spend_logs_for_previous_response_id
methods.description: Fetches all spend logs associated with a previous response ID from the database.
